title: Massaging around this area for 30–60 seconds #stressrelief #vagusnerve #shorts #selfcare
description:
can help calm your body faster than you think. This region is rich in nerve endings connected to the Vagus Nerve, which plays a major role in activating your body’s relaxation response. Gentle stimulation here can increase activity of the Parasympathetic Nervous System, helping slow your heart rate, relax tense muscles, and lower the stress hormone Cortisol.

Just one minute of gentle circular massage can signal your nervous system to shift from “fight-or-flight” to a calmer, more relaxed state.

#nervoussystem #relaxation
